policy: All politicians and original position labels retained. Source years, winner flags and designations are source claims. Non-empty public API fields take precedence only for the same source-table ID and matching first/last names. Changed names remain separate registry_id records with has_identity_conflict=true. All original snapshots remain in source_records; source_identity_conflicts lists conflicting IDs. No family relationships, current office or document signature are inferred. The Governor/Mayor/DE/ADE signatory matcher separately uses officials.json.
